saints.name: St. Kilian
saints.title: Bishop and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: An Irish missionary bishop who won Franconia for Christ and died a martyr at Würzburg…
biography: Kilian was an Irishman, said to have been of noble birth, who left his native land with companions to preach the Gospel on the Continent, as so many Irish monks did in that age. He went to Rome, received a mission and episcopal consecration, and settled at Würzburg in Franconia, where he converted Duke Gozbert and many of his people.

According to his passion he rebuked the duke for an unlawful marriage, and was murdered with his companions Colman and Totnan about the year 689. He is honored as the apostle of Franconia, and Würzburg keeps his memory as its patron.
saints.knownFor: Evangelizing Franconia and his martyrdom at Würzburg.
